subject: Invitation: Customer spotlight panel at ‘Scale & Serve Summit’ (Oct 22) - BrightLayer
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation: Customer spotlight panel at ‘Scale & Serve Summit’ (Oct 22) - BrightLayer

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re doing well — I’m Vanessa from Redwood Inference. We loved BrightLayer’s talk at EdgeCon this spring and would like to invite one of your engineering leaders to join a short customer spotlight panel we’re hosting as part of our virtual "Scale & Serve Summit" on Oct 22 (60-minute program).

Format: 20-min panel (3 customers + moderator), 10-min audience Q&A. Target audience: engineering + platform leads.

Why we’d love BrightLayer on the panel: your team’s recent rollout of private deployments and smart routing maps closely to the topics we want to showcase (cost/latency tradeoffs, observability). We’d aim to highlight concrete outcomes (latency reduction, cost per token) — your team can share whatever you’re comfortable with.

Logistics: we’ll take care of production, provide a short speaker brief, and publish the recording. We also promote panelists in event PR and social. We do not charge panelists; if there are any compliance or comms constraints we can accommodate.

Would you be open to a quick 15-min pre-call next week to confirm a speaker and go over the agenda? I attached a draft agenda and our speaker guide. If you prefer, here’s my scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-sales-call

Thanks — looking forward to hearing if BrightLayer is interested.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: brightlayer_proposed_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), speaker_guidelines_redwood_v2.docx (DOCX)

From: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@brightlayer.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer Events <events@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: Customer spotlight panel at ‘Scale & Serve Summit’ (Oct 22) - BrightLayer

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the invite. I’m interested and I think our Head of Platform, Miguel Ortiz (cc’d on internal side once I confirm) would be the right person to join. A few quick questions before I confirm with him: 

- Approx. time window on Oct 22 (what hour are you running the program)?
- Will we be asked to share any internal metrics in the session or could we keep examples high-level?
- Any honorarium or PR materials you provide?

We’re generally fine with short pre-recorded demos or a live conversation. I’ll check Miguel’s availability and aim to get back to you by EOD Friday (9/12).

Best,
Hannah Liu
Head of Developer Relations
BrightLayer

Hi Hannah — great, thank you. Answering your questions inline: 

- Time window: the Summit runs 9:00am–12:30pm PT; the customer panel slot would be ~10:30–11:00 PT (we record and will keep the panel to the 20-min window).
- Metrics: we do not require sharing raw internal telemetry. We ask for outcome-level signals (e.g., "reduced inference latency by X% after rollout") — if you prefer, you can present percentages or relative improvements without raw logs. We’ll also accept a high-level bulleted case study instead of numbers.
- Honorarium/PR: we do not pay an honorarium but we offer event PR (social posts, short quote attribution) and feature the customer in a follow-up case study if you’re interested. If you need a press review or comms sign-off, we can coordinate with your team.

If Miguel is confirmed, can you share the speaker full name, title, and a 2–3 sentence bio? Also let us know if you prefer live or pre-recorded.

If convenient, I’ve penciled in a 15-min pre-call slot (calendar link above). Otherwise we can schedule via your events address.

Thanks — excited to have BrightLayer considered.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
